docs.title: The natural history of selborne
docs.description: The natural history and antiquities of Selborne, in the county of Southampton, first published in 1789. Gilbert White's letters to Thomas Pennant and Daines Barrington record the birds, plants, weather and village life of one Hampshire parish over twenty years, and the book has stayed in print ever since.
docs.creator: White, Gilbert, 1720-1793

docs.title: Replication of a dual-task interference effect in visual working memory
description: Preregistration of a direct replication of a dual-task interference experiment in visual working memory, with the planned sample size, the exclusion rules and the analysis fixed before data collection.
Data and materials are deposited alongside the registration.
creator: Example, Research Group

docs.title: French country cooking
docs.description: A collection of regional recipes from Provence, Burgundy and Normandy with notes on the markets and the seasons each dish belongs to, scanned from a library copy and released under the old Creative Commons public domain dedication.
docs.creator: Anonymous

docs.title: Introductory statistics, second edition
docs.description: An open textbook for a first course in statistics: descriptive statistics, probability, sampling distributions, confidence intervals and hypothesis tests, with worked examples drawn from public data sets and exercises at the end of every chapter.
creator: Open Textbook Project

docs.title: Local history walks
docs.description: Six self-guided walks through the old town with notes on the buildings, the trades that worked in them and the people recorded in the parish registers, written by the local history society for its members.
docs.creator: Local History Society

docs.title: A dissertation under a non-commercial licence
docs.description: A doctoral dissertation on the economics of municipal water supply, deposited by its author under a Creative Commons licence that allows sharing for non-commercial purposes only, which the Commons cannot pass on under CC BY-SA.
docs.creator: Example, Author

docs.title: An annual report under a no-derivatives licence
docs.description: The annual report of a foundation, released for sharing in its original form only, with the financial statements and the list of grants made in the year, which the Commons cannot excerpt or pass on under its own licence.
docs.creator: Example Foundation

docs.title: A library scan with no licence URL
docs.description: A modern management textbook scanned for the Archive's lending library. The Archive states no licence for it, and until 2026-11-10 the connector stored it as public domain, which it is not; the item carries no licenseurl field, so the live query no longer returns it.
docs.creator: Example, Writer
